name: sdlc-foundry
description: An agentic SDLC platform: Claude Code agents, slash commands and Copier templates from idea to Kubernetes with GitOps.

plugins.name: svc
plugins.description: Spec-driven pipeline for every service shape: spec → plan → failing acceptance tests → parallel coders → quality ‖ tests ‖ security → verify against the spec → PR.

plugins.name: web
plugins.description: Agents for Next.js (App Router, pnpm, TypeScript) web repos: coder, tester, deployment, observability, release.

plugins.name: app
plugins.description: Tombstones only (the 4.x app commands moved to /system and /component); leaves the marketplace in 6.0.

plugins.name: svc-go
plugins.description: Agents for Go service repos (chi, slog, golangci-lint, distroless): coder, tester, deployment, observability, release.

plugins.name: svc-java
plugins.description: Agents for Java service repos (Spring Boot 3, Maven, JDK 21, distroless): coder, tester, deployment, observability, release.

plugins.name: gitops
plugins.description: Tombstones only (the 4.x gitops commands moved to the noun plugins); leaves the marketplace in 6.0.

plugins.name: shared
plugins.description: Common quality and security agents plus the cplat launcher and session hooks.

plugins.name: system
plugins.description: Spec-driven features across a system's components (gitops-app repo): /system:new creates a system, /system:status shows it, /system:spec writes the system spec, /system:plan assigns its criteria to the component repos (ADR-011/026), /system:ship ships it unattended in plan order (ADR-042). Provides the planner agent.

plugins.name: component
plugins.description: The component commands: /component:new, add, set, remove, spec, plan, build, verify, check, ship, fix and release. Component repos run the spec-driven pipeline (spec, plan, build, verify, ship); gitops-app repos add, change and remove components. Agents come from the svc and language plugins.

plugins.name: api
plugins.description: The api noun: /api:list shows the APIs a system declares, with provider and consumers.

plugins.name: resource
plugins.description: The resource noun: /resource:add and /resource:remove declare named, typed and external resources (postgres databases) of a system in system.yaml.

plugins.name: instance
plugins.description: The instance noun: /instance:promote, /instance:secret and /instance:verify act on where a component runs, per environment.

plugins.name: issue
plugins.description: The issue noun: /issue:triage routes GitHub issues to specs and fixes; /issue:report files a platform issue.

plugins.name: platform
plugins.description: The platform noun: /platform:doctor, update, fleet, runs and retro look after the platform itself.
